name: What materials are commonly used for backsplashes?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for backsplashes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common backsplash materials include ceramic and porcelain tile, natural stone (like marble, granite, or travertine), glass tiles, stainless steel, and sometimes even wallpaper or painted surfaces. Each material offers different benefits in terms of durability, maintenance, and aesthetics. Ceramic and porcelain are popular for their versatility and cost-effectiveness, while natural stone offers a luxurious look but may require more maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials include ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, glass, and stainless steel.
